faqs.q: Why is Hungarian SEO different from other countries?
faqs.a: Hungarian is unrelated to its neighbouring languages, with complex grammar that changes word forms dramatically. Translated keywords almost never match real Hungarian searches. Proper Hungarian SEO starts from Hungarian search behaviour, which is slower to research and far more effective.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take in Hungary?
faqs.a: Early movement in 2 to 3 months, meaningful results in 4 to 6. Budapest's competitive terms take longer; Debrecen, Szeged, and regional markets usually move faster because proper Hungarian-language SEO is rare there.

faqs.q: Should I target tourists as well as locals?
faqs.a: If you are in Budapest or around Balaton, yes, but as a separate effort. Tourists search in English and German with different intent than locals. I build separate keyword maps and pages for each audience rather than mixing them.

faqs.q: How do you handle the Balaton season?
faqs.a: Backwards from the peak. We decide which summer keywords must rank, then build content and profiles 4 to 6 months ahead so they mature before the searches begin. Starting in June for a July season is starting too late.

faqs.q: Will I work with you directly?
faqs.a: Yes. I run a one-person studio, so the person doing your Hungarian keyword research is the person building your pages and reporting on them. No handoffs, no account managers.
